correctness.rationale: The recurrence starts at ordered distinct odd primes (p,q), stops when their sum is a power of two, otherwise appends its least odd prime factor. Each newly appended odd prime r divides p+q with r<= (p+q)/2 < max(p,q), so max of the ordered pair decreases after at most two transitions and trajectories terminate. Independently enumerated all 656 odd primes <=4919 and all 656*655=429680 distinct ordered seeds, using a separate prime sieve, smallest-odd-prime-factor transition and memoized depth, and reproduced 22 optimal ceiling entries M(l) for 2<=l<=23, unique depth-23 pair (4007,4919), and upper bound 22 for every preceding ceiling. This IS exhaustive for the finite seed ceiling, since any seed ceiling lower than a witnessed minimum lies within the enumerated set. It does not claim any value M(l) for l>=24 or all-prime asymptotics.
